en.text: Harbor City and Ridgeway United ended in a 1-1 draw. Sami Halloran opened the scoring for Harbor City with a powerful shot from 10 meters. Ravi Kendrick equalized just minutes later with a fast strike from 14 meters.
rejections: the score is level, no team leads

zh.text: Harbor City 与 Ridgeway United 战成 1-1。Sami Halloran 首开纪录，随后 Ravi Kendrick 扳平比分。两队控球率相差较大，Ridgeway United 射门更多但预期进球较低。

en.text: Harbor City and Ridgeway United finished with a 1-1 draw, despite Harbor holding only 40% possession against Ridgeway's 60%. Sami Halloran opened the scoring for Harbor City in the 8th minute with a 103 km/h shot from 10 meters (xG 0.77). Ridgeway United equalized five minutes later when Ravi Kendrick scored from 14 meters at 99 km/h (xG 0.08). Harbor City dominated the attack with six shots compared to one for Ridgeway, yet both teams struggled to convert chances.
